doc: Act III field tunables (M5-A3P-1001; act3 beat sheets). Read by Ch05Zone through a zone scene's hold_field_path (game/levels/ch05/ch05_zone.gd): hollowmere.tscn, reedhollow.tscn, kite.tscn. hold: the no-fail held input, as ch09_field.json's (CutsceneHoldGate; docs/kb/tech/cutscenes.md 'Held input'): between <<event hold_input <prompt>>> and <<event hold_input_end>> the scene's time runs only while `action` is held. prompts maps each event's prompt id to its loc key (game/data/loc/ch17.csv onward): Ch17's ledger page-turns and first lamp; Ch18's maiden flight and farewell-tide; Ch19's hitch and engine; the Ending's strain on the Kite's sheet.
